# Tests, CI, bindings and verification index {#sec-ch10}

This chapter documents how pyharp is verified and what a user can rely on. @sec-ch10-test-suite lists the tests
that exist, those the build registers and those the continuous-integration job runs, with the result of running
all of them. @sec-ch10-packaging states which pydisort versions pyharp accepts and what happens when the version it
was built against differs from the one it runs with. @sec-ch10-bindings compares the C++ options with the Python
bindings and the type stubs. @sec-ch10-index indexes the executable checks of this report. Appendix C
(@sec-appc) lists the registered `ctest` tests at the pin.
